$comment: The dated, finite grandfather list for `validate:adr-status` (TASK-S0-O3, 2026-09-24).
`validate:adr-status` fails when an ADR whose own document says `Proposed` is cited
from SHIPPED SOURCE — a non-Markdown, non-spec file under `packages/*/src/`. On the day
the gate landed, three ADRs were in exactly that state, and they are the three listed
below. Shipping the gate without them would have meant either a permanently red
`validate:all` or no gate at all.
THIS LIST IS NOT A PERMISSION LIST AND IT CANNOT GROW BY ACCIDENT.
`maxGrandfathered` must EQUAL `entries.length`, so a fourth entry is a visible,
reviewable edit that a reader can refuse — and a fourth entry means a fourth decision
has become load-bearing while unsigned, which is a decision to raise, not a line to add.
IT EMPTIES ITSELF. Rule `grandfather-discharged` fails when an entry's ADR is no longer
`Proposed`, or is no longer cited from shipped source. So the day an owner flips a
`Status:` line the gate goes RED until the entry is deleted and `maxGrandfathered`
lowered in the same change — the same one-way ratchet shape as `maxUndocumented` and
`maxProposedCitedFromCode` in packages/tooling/scripts/adr-registry.json.
STATUS IS DELIBERATELY NOT MIRRORED HERE. The validator reads each document's own
`Status:` line, exactly as `validate:adr-references` does and for the same reason:
a second copy of the same fact is a second place for it to be wrong. See the
$comment in adr-registry.json.
WHY THIS GATE EXISTS BESIDE `maxProposedCitedFromCode`, which counts the same debt.
The registry's ceiling is a NUMBER and this list is a set of NAMES, and the difference
is load-bearing. With the ceiling at 3, accepting one ADR and letting one new unsigned
decision become load-bearing in the same release leaves the arithmetic at 3 — equal to
the ceiling, silently green. Naming the three closes that hole: a Proposed ADR that is
not on this list fails whatever the arithmetic says. Proven by seeded fixture in
adr-status.spec.ts ('a swap that keeps the arithmetic ceiling intact still fails').
discharged: 2026-10-01, at the merge of origin/main: the owner accepted ADR-18, ADR-19 and ADR-20 on 2026-09-26 (upstream 4885d0e5), so all three entries recorded on 2026-09-24 were deleted and maxGrandfathered lowered 3 -> 0 in the same change, as each entry's `exit` clause required.
